turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Yes—request cancellation as soon as possible, before the order ships. We don’t have a fixed cancellation window, and cancellation isn’t guaranteed once an order has been placed, especially if it’s already packaged. Once it ships, it can’t be canceled, but you may request a return for a refund. Personalized items can’t be canceled once personalization is complete.
If you mean your order, please sign in so I can check its status.

If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
If your order is successfully canceled and a refund is issued, most refunds appear within 2–3 business days; some banks or payment processors take 5–7 business days. We don’t have a confirmed timeframe for when a full-order cancellation refund is issued.
If the order ships before it can be canceled, it can’t be canceled; you can request a return for a refund instead.
